Rice all week, still annoyed about my salad, stayed till 2am again, checked their stories twice, clapping when the plane lands. Those are things I'd drop in the gym group chat. It slips sometimes, a few 'Oops' tags that are just filler and one or two lines that make one side cuter, but it's the only one that talks like my friends. Fun is right behind it and honestly the most even: the week in my cart, the notes app, replies getting slower and slower, the hustle line. Scenario is fun with better setups; the 'can you talk tonight?' text and the bill landing between you make the question feel like a real moment. Quest is clean but 'side quest' and 'daily tasks' feel forced on me, though 'level up' works because I'm literally chasing PRs. Kind is clear and fair but reads like a school counselor wrote it; I'd answer it honest and forget it. Oracle is the one I'd bounce on. 'The cards recall', 'a dark card', 'the crystal ball replays' in front of every single question makes it feel like a carnival booth, and on caregiving it's just wrong. Most of these quick takes are the same sentence across all six, so the scenes and the one-detail jokes are where anybody wins. If you want guys like me to send this to friends, lead with the callout lines and keep the options even.
